text: Tappoo, the Fiji Rugby sponsor whose logo appears on the national team's shorts, is part of the Tappoos Group of Companies, a family-owned Fijian company founded in 1941 by Tappoo Kanji.
short: Tappoo is a family-owned Fijian group.

source.name: Fiji Rugby Union: Our Sponsors (Tappoo City profile)
source.quote: Tappoos Group of Companies is a well – known, family owned – Fijian company that was founded back in 1941. Tappoo comes from the name Tappoo Kanji.
source.note: Undated club sponsors page; date is the day it was opened. The same profile says 'Tappoo is the exclusive distribution partner of Fiji Rakavi merchandise and sponsors for Fiji Water flying Fijians, Fiji Airways 7s teams.'
